claim: On Windows sjasmplus warns on backslashes in the source path, the pinned assembler may not be found or built, and an autocrlf checkout can fail size budgets.

evidence.text: sjasmplus warns on backslashes in the source path (Windows; forward slashes passed); sjasm.py cannot find or build the pinned assembler on Windows.
evidence.quote: sjasm.py cannot find or build the pinned assembler on Windows; a local 1.24.0

evidence.text: An autocrlf checkout on Windows failed 18 size budgets and listed docs twice.
evidence.quote: an autocrlf checkout on Windows failed 18 size budgets and listed docs twice.
